notes.title: August 2019 Patch Update
notes.content:
A new update has been released for Sword Art Online: Fatal Bullet. You can find here all the information regarding the changes, adjustments and new content:

Maximum Level 285 → 300

3 new high-difficulty quests added to online co-op


     LV300 HC Co-op: Special Challenge α
     LV300 HC Co-op: Special Challenge β
     LV300 HC Co-op: Special Challenge γ


6 new costumes added to Lobby


     Alice in her childhood costume (Maid clothes)
     Military Waitress
     Alice in her childhood costume (Maid clothes/Variation)
     Military Waitress (Variation)
     Daybreak Lawson Coat F
     Nocturnal Lawson Coat M


5 new accessories added (also available at the accessory trader)


     Alice Childhood Headband
     Military Waitress Hat
     Katamari Damacy
     Pooka from DIGDUG
     PAC-MAN


1 new painting added to Avatar Customization

    
 Genpei Toma Den face Painting


Added “Grand Master Class” to BoB Simulation


     Unable to play the quest without installation of DLC1 which includes BoB simulation.
     Rank 11 weapons drop (The DLC's original ones do not drop)
     Weapons which would be more Epic drop
     Preliminaries participants is 8 includes players.
     Finals participants is 16 includes players ←would decrease if its processing load is hard
     Shiki and Lievre join the quest


Added total bounty rewards


 Total bounty rewards are set from 140000000 to 160000000


New rank11 weapons「Series Type-Z」available in new HC Co-op


     AMR Tiamat Type-Z
     SPB Rapier Type-Z
     SPB Potassium Type-Z
     Valkyrie Type-Z


"Release weapons potential ability" has been added to Lisbeth's Workshop

Enable to make the weapons individual power value limit strong from by 5% to by 10 % voluntarily, which is required both new item "Release potential ability IC" and credit.

Online battle hero adjustments

Several bugs fixed

notes.title: Sword Art Online: Fatal Bullet - April 2019 Patch Update
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31713285/2bfb2088dc85dfcd0e6ee20d05f4af9dd592feab.png

A new update is coming to Sword Art Online: Fatal Bullet today, April 18th. You can find here all the important information regarding the changes, adjustments and new content: 

Maximum Level 275 → 285

3 new high-difficulty quests added to online co-op:

 LV285 HC Co-op: Special Invitation α
 LV285 HC Co-op: Special Invitation β
 LV285 HC Co-op: Special Invitation γ


3 new costumes added to Lobby

 Heart of a Smith F (Anime GGO Lisbeth Costume) along with a variation
 Tamer Suit F (Anime GGO Silica Costume) along with a variation
 Howling Wolf M (Anime GGO Klein Costume) along with a variation


3 new accessories added (also available at the accessory trader)

 CSS Beret (Anime GGO Lisbeth Hat)
 Soldier Goggles (Anime GGO Klein Hat)
 Senior Officer Cap (Officer Cap [variation] [unisex])


Added total bounty rewards

 Total bounty rewards are set from 120000000 to 140000000
 Accessories (Legendary) and rank 11 weapons (both come with the special effect) are available. The effect level of the accessories or weapons will be set to the maximum.


New rank11 weapons「Series Type-Z」available in new HC Co-op

 Long Stroke Type-Z
 Kagemitsu G9 Type-Z
 Pandemonium Type-Z
 Deneb Kaitos Type-Z


Adjustments for more than rank 9 weapons

 Sword and Sword&Gun: critical rate up by 5%
 HG Kuroneko: adjusted strength since it was relatively inferior to the other weapons.
 Crimson Roar: adjusted strength since it was relatively inferior to the other weapons.


Added events available to be viewed on the bed

 Yui
 Itsuki


Added option to choose multiple materials for weapon transformations 

Increased the limit of item storage and item Box. The limits will increase as follows: 

 Item storage 400→ 500
 Item box 700 → 800


Online battle hero adjustments

Several bugs fixed

notes.title: Sword Art Online: Re Hollow Fragment Pre-Order Purchase Delay
notes.content:
Unfortunately we will not be able to grant Sword Art Online: Re: Hollow Fragment today for pre-order purchasers as originally planned. We are looking into the issue and hope to have a resolution and new release date soon. Please stand by for more updates. Thank you for your patience! 

UPDATE (March 30, 2018)
Sword Art Online: Re: Hollow Fragment is now available to all who pre-ordered it. If it hasn't already shown up in your game library, please restart Steam.

Thank you for waiting, and we hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: SWORD ART ONLINE: FATAL BULLET'S SEASON PASS AND FIRST PAID DLC “AMBUSH OF THE IMPOSTERS” ANNOUNCED
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31713285/157cb632ddcec7d5230e4862bd8c7e41091817e4.jpgBANDAI NAMCO Entertainment announces the Season Pass and the DLC “Ambush Of The Imposters” for SWORD ART ONLINE: FATAL BULLET.
The Season Pass will also include the upcoming DLCs “Betrayal Of Comrades” and “Collapse Of Balance”. 

The first DLC “Ambush Of The Imposters” will feature a brand new story arc with a new dungeon and boss battle. Following rumors about enemy ArFA-sys units, the protagonist and its companions start investigating the rumors with the cooperation of Yamikaze, Dyne and Musketeer X…Another story starts.
Further features of the first DLC for SWORD ART ONLINE: FATAL BULLET include:
• New playable characters: Dyne, Yamikaze and Musketeer X 
• New game mode Bullet Of Bullets: Pick your characters and fight and fight Kirito and the other characters from SWORD ART ONLINE in this new offline mode
• 4vs4 Deathmatch Multiplayer Mode (available in Hero Battle and Avatar Battle): fight as teams of four against each other and without Boss enemy.

The two others DLC of the Season Pass will feature new characters: 
• Clarence and Shirley (Alternative Gun Gale Online) for the DLC “Betrayal Of Comrades”
• Alice and Eugeo (Alicization) for the DLC “Collapse Of Balance”

STAY CONNECTED:
• Official Website: http://www.swordartonline-game.com 
• Official Facebook Page: https://www.facebook.com/swordartonlinegames

notes.title: Patch Note 11th March 2018
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31713285/7ade33574ad597d9b72ebe6f11bd25187143fc79.jpgA patch has been pushed lately to fix some issues on SWORD ART ONLINE: FATAL BULLET and we hope it has improved your experience with the game. We are also investigating more bugs to fix them soon.

Thanks for playing Sword Art Online: Fatal Bullet

List of changes:
Fixed issue with the game going back to the title screen after changing the setting in the “ADVANCE OPTION”.
Improved stability when using Ultra Wide Monitor.
Adjusted balance with online matching.
Ability to acquire items after defeating enemies in Online co-op quest.
Fixed issue with proceeding past loading screen.
